hook: Congress just changed hands. Now what?
caption:
🗳️ Democrats won the House and Senate. New Congress from January 2027: analysts expect gridlock.
💥 US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, right in the Strait of Hormuz. Oil route tension can move fuel prices.
🤝 Russia confirms Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November.
🕊️ Deadly strikes in Gaza test the ceasefire from October 2025.
🍑 Georgia elects the first Black woman governor of any US state.
Which story surprised you most?
Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.

Cover: Congress just changed hands. Now what?
📷 Martin Falbisoner (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

1/5 Democrats win House and Senate (7+)
Democrats won both chambers, flipping 7+ Senate seats. Trump's last two years now face a Democratic Congress.
📷 Martin Falbisoner (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

2/5 US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island (20M)
The US carried out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island. It sits in Hormuz, a key route for world oil.
🎨 AI-generated image

3/5 Ukraine talks set for Abu Dhabi (Nov 10)
Russia confirmed it will join US-mediated talks with Ukraine. Both sides will sit at one table, with the US in between.
📷 Clint Ian Pinto (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

4/5 Gaza ceasefire under strain (5)
Israeli strikes killed at least five, Gaza health officials say. They test a US-brokered ceasefire from October 2025.
🎨 AI-generated image

5/5 Georgia makes history (1st)
Keisha Lance Bottoms was elected governor of Georgia. She's the first Black woman elected governor of any state.
📷 Harrison Keely (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia
